metadata.title: Palantir Stock Nears Fresh Low Amid Freefall<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Stock Nears Fresh Low
Palantir Technologies can’t catch a break. The stock sank Thursday for a seventh straight trading session, putting it on track to close at a 12-month low.
